title: Your Work Style Quiz
description: Everyone switches between habits during a workday. Ten short scenarios show which ones you lean on most. Pick the answer that sounds most like you on an ordinary day, not on your best one.

elements.name: newProject
elements.title: A brand-new project lands on your desk. What do you do first?

choices.text: Break it into milestones and sketch a timeline
Brainstorm a dozen possible directions
Study the requirements until every detail is clear
Find out who else is involved and set up a kickoff chat

elements.name: usefulMeeting
elements.title: Which meeting sounds most useful to you?

choices.text: A round table where everyone gets heard
A focused review of one piece of work, step by step
An open whiteboard session where no idea is off limits
A short check-in with a clear agenda and action items

elements.name: deadlineMoved
elements.title: A deadline suddenly moves up by a week. What's your first move?

choices.text: Decide what can be trimmed without lowering quality
Rework the schedule and reassign tasks
Pull the team together and check how everyone is coping
Look for a clever shortcut nobody has tried yet

elements.name: helpfulFeedback
elements.title: What kind of feedback helps you most?

choices.text: Big-picture reactions: does the idea excite people?
A conversation about how the work landed with others
Clear next steps in order of priority
Specific, detailed notes on what to improve

elements.name: workspace
elements.title: Your desk or screen is usually...

choices.text: Organized with lists, calendars, and labeled folders
Sparse, with only what the current task needs
Covered in sticky notes, sketches, and open tabs
Full of chat windows and shared documents

elements.name: stuckOnProblem
elements.title: You hit a problem you can't solve alone. You...

choices.text: Ask a colleague to talk it through with you
Step away and let a new angle come to you
Dig into the root cause until it makes sense
List the options and weigh them one by one

elements.name: proudestMoment
elements.title: Your team just finished a big project. What makes you proudest?

choices.text: The finished work holds up to close inspection
Everyone pulled together and enjoyed the process
We delivered on time and on budget
We tried something nobody had done before

elements.name: energyDrain
elements.title: Which situation drains your energy the fastest?

choices.text: Doing the same routine task over and over
Last-minute changes with no explanation
Being rushed into delivering sloppy work
Working in isolation with no one to bounce ideas off

elements.name: colleaguesAskFor
elements.title: Colleagues most often come to you for...

choices.text: Getting a messy situation under control
Fresh ideas when they feel stuck
Advice on handling a tricky conversation
A careful second pair of eyes
A good conversation that strengthened a working relationship
One piece of work polished to a high standard
A notebook full of new possibilities
Every item on today's list checked off

calculatedValues.name: sparkScore
calculatedValues.expression: iif({newProject} = 'spark', 1, 0) + iif({usefulMeeting} = 'spark', 1, 0) + iif({deadlineMoved} = 'spark', 1, 0) + iif({helpfulFeedback} = 'spark', 1, 0) + iif({workspace} = 'spark', 1, 0) + iif({stuckOnProblem} = 'spark', 1, 0) + iif({proudestMoment} = 'spark', 1, 0) + iif({energyDrain} = 'spark', 1, 0) + iif({colleaguesAskFor} = 'spark', 1, 0) + iif({perfectDayEnd} = 'spark', 1, 0)

calculatedValues.name: plannerScore
calculatedValues.expression: iif({newProject} = 'planner', 1, 0) + iif({usefulMeeting} = 'planner', 1, 0) + iif({deadlineMoved} = 'planner', 1, 0) + iif({helpfulFeedback} = 'planner', 1, 0) + iif({workspace} = 'planner', 1, 0) + iif({stuckOnProblem} = 'planner', 1, 0) + iif({proudestMoment} = 'planner', 1, 0) + iif({energyDrain} = 'planner', 1, 0) + iif({colleaguesAskFor} = 'planner', 1, 0) + iif({perfectDayEnd} = 'planner', 1, 0)

calculatedValues.name: weaverScore
calculatedValues.expression: iif({newProject} = 'weaver', 1, 0) + iif({usefulMeeting} = 'weaver', 1, 0) + iif({deadlineMoved} = 'weaver', 1, 0) + iif({helpfulFeedback} = 'weaver', 1, 0) + iif({workspace} = 'weaver', 1, 0) + iif({stuckOnProblem} = 'weaver', 1, 0) + iif({proudestMoment} = 'weaver', 1, 0) + iif({energyDrain} = 'weaver', 1, 0) + iif({colleaguesAskFor} = 'weaver', 1, 0) + iif({perfectDayEnd} = 'weaver', 1, 0)

calculatedValues.name: crafterScore
calculatedValues.expression: iif({newProject} = 'crafter', 1, 0) + iif({usefulMeeting} = 'crafter', 1, 0) + iif({deadlineMoved} = 'crafter', 1, 0) + iif({helpfulFeedback} = 'crafter', 1, 0) + iif({workspace} = 'crafter', 1, 0) + iif({stuckOnProblem} = 'crafter', 1, 0) + iif({proudestMoment} = 'crafter', 1, 0) + iif({energyDrain} = 'crafter', 1, 0) + iif({colleaguesAskFor} = 'crafter', 1, 0) + iif({perfectDayEnd} = 'crafter', 1, 0)

calculatedValues.name: workStyle
calculatedValues.expression: iif({sparkScore} >= {plannerScore} and {sparkScore} >= {weaverScore} and {sparkScore} >= {crafterScore}, 'spark', iif({plannerScore} >= {weaverScore} and {plannerScore} >= {crafterScore}, 'planner', iif({weaverScore} >= {crafterScore}, 'weaver', 'crafter')))

completedHtmlOnCondition.html:
You lean most toward: The Idea Spark

Blank pages don't scare you; they invite you in. You tend to reach for "what if" before "how," and colleagues often borrow your energy when a project needs a push to get going.

Where you shine: Turning a vague brief into several directions worth testing.

A habit worth trying: Keep a running idea log so good thoughts survive the next new thing, and hand promising concepts to someone who enjoys the finishing stretch.

Your mix: Idea Spark {sparkScore} · Steady Planner {plannerScore} · Team Weaver {weaverScore} · Detail Crafter {crafterScore} (out of 10). A close second score means you switch between those habits easily.

A conversation starter for teams, not a psychological assessment.

You lean most toward: The Steady Planner

You like knowing where the finish line is and how to get there. Goals turn into sequences in your head almost automatically, and teams relax a little when you hold the schedule.

Where you shine: Untangling messy priorities and keeping commitments visible.

A habit worth trying: Treat the plan as a draft, not a contract. Review it when facts change, and set aside time for work that has no deadline yet.

You lean most toward: The Team Weaver

Your first instinct is to think about the people around the work. You notice who has gone quiet, who should meet whom, and how a decision will land before it is announced.

Where you shine: Building trust, smoothing handoffs, and keeping a group talking to each other.

A habit worth trying: Block out solo hours for your own tasks, and remember that saying "I disagree" kindly is also a way of looking after the team.

A conversation starter for teams, not a psychological assessment.

You lean most toward: The Detail Crafter

You read the fine print and enjoy it. Small inconsistencies jump out at you, and when your name is on something, you want it to stand up to any question.

Where you shine: Catching problems early and raising the bar on quality.

A habit worth trying: Agree on a "good enough" line before you start, and show rough drafts sooner so feedback arrives while changes are still cheap.
